limitations: This is agent-assisted labeling by a coding agent, not independent human assessment, a new model inference run, or legal/field validation. No separate model/provider API was called.

Only masked/batch-3.jsonl, protocol.md, question-targets.json, data/sources/evidence-candidates.json and data/sources/manifest.json were read. No arm key, other batches/scores, original logs, previous evaluations, human labels, Fable results, source code, external research or app execution were used.

All fields of every stored output were read. Source verification is limited to supplied registry metadata and registered excerpts; the referenced PDFs, snapshots, price tables and processor lists were not opened, fetched or rehashed. Input/output SHA-256 values were recomputed from UTF-8 JSON.stringify of the stored objects and matched the supplied hashes.

Explicit arm labels were absent; residual schema, wording, state fields, evidence density and legal-metadata structure remain visible. structuralClues records those observations without guessing an arm. This is arm-label masking, not complete blinding.

claims:[] means no concrete named processor/authorization/acceptance, numeric price, emissions factor or reduction claim was found. Null cost/carbon values, missing-data statements, requested future quotes/factors, input mass/date and legal article numbers are not claims in those categories. No synthetic no-claim quotation is emitted.

citations:[] means no concrete citation was found, not a false citation and not perfect citation accuracy. exact-registered denotes identity/locator/version/hash consistency with supplied registry, not case-specific legal suitability. partial-registered preserves missing locator detail or version/hash information; unregistered is not proof of real-world falsity.

Repeated source+locator+version references within an output are represented once. Evidence metadata, legalCitations claims, route evidenceIds and other repeated references were examined together; distinct claim scopes are explained in citation reasons. Numbered annex references outside those bundles and distinct provision locators remain separate. Generic calls to check law without a specific provision are not concrete citations.

Questions are scored only against exact case target IDs. Specific questions and imperatives count; descriptive statements that data are unknown or unconfirmed do not by themselves count as asked. Missing questions have empty evidence arrays. Empty critical arrays are not-applicable (N/A), not a 100% score.

The frozen four review cases are two mixed/multilayer cases, one label contradiction and one hazardous-solvent-contact case, not four independently proven hazardous cases. This batch includes only the label-contradiction case among those predefined case IDs; absence of the others is not an omitted batch row.

No summary metric, cross-arm comparison, causal system/model claim or field-safety/optimal-route conclusion is made. The frozen checklist is retrospective; stored inputs are synthetic and the audit adds no field facts.
